description: This file defines the EmployeeMembershipService class, which provides business logic for managing employee memberships within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, retrieving, searching, counting, and deleting employee membership records, utilizing an EmployeeMembershipDao data access object.

classes.name: EmployeeMembershipService
classes.description: Service class providing business logic for employee memberships, including CRUD operations and search functionalities.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipDao
methods.description: Lazy loads and returns an instance of EmployeeMembershipDao.

methods.name: saveEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Saves an EmployeeMembership record using the DAO.

methods.name: getEmployeeMembershipById
methods.description: Retrieves an EmployeeMembership by employee number and record ID.

methods.name: searchEmployeeMembership
methods.description: Searches for EmployeeMembership records based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeMembershipsCount
methods.description: Counts EmployeeMembership records matching the filter criteria.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeMemberships
methods.description: Deletes multiple EmployeeMembership records for a given employee.
